wikipediaSummary.title: Californication (album)
wikipediaSummary.description: 1999 studio album by Red Hot Chili Peppers
wikipediaSummary.extract: Californication is the seventh studio album by the American rock band Red Hot Chili Peppers, released on June 8, 1999, on Warner Bros. Records. It was produced by Rick Rubin. Along with Blood Sugar Sex Magik, Californication is one of the band's best-selling albums.
